description: Structured reference for writing a CIVIL NX model through the API (civil_write_tables): the material standard names CIVIL NX knows (46 concrete standards), material fields per type, grades known to work, every user section shape with the order of its dimensions (vSIZE), catalogue section examples, plate thickness, beam / truss / plate element rows and plate STYPE codes, support constraint strings, load case / self weight / nodal load / combination rows, creep-shrinkage and strength-gain code options — each with its source: MIDAS IT's open-source midas-civil-python library (MIT), the MIDAS API manual, or behaviour measured on live CIVIL NX. Also every option list in midas-civil-python (148): the 67 static load case types, beam / pressure / plane load options, combination types, the 15 moving-load codes with their standard vehicles (Eurocode LM1–LM4 incl. UK NA SV/SOV, fatigue and rail; Indian road and rail), point springs and elastic links, temperature, tendons and prestress, construction stages, response spectrum / time history, units and result components. The grade lists inside each standard and the steel section catalogues are CIVIL NX's own and published nowhere: the answer says how to confirm one safely. Topics: overview, materials, sections (shape: one shape), thickness, elements, supports, loads, moving_loads, boundaries, temperature, tendons, construction, dynamic, units, results, time_dependent, python; search alone looks through every list and vehicle. Needs no model and no account.

search.description: With topic materials: only standards / grades containing this ("EN", "C40"). Alone or with topic search: every option list and vehicle in the library whose name or values contain it ("LM1", "SV 196", "tendon", "SRSS").

shape.description: sections: one user shape code, e.g. SB, H, B, P.
